name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx hosting for three SSL-enabled virtual sites, including static content, virtual hosts, self-signed certificates, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall rules, and SSH/sysctl hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis service enablement, logging, authentication, PID directory management, and cleanup of selected generated configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python 3, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL initialization and database provisioning, GitHub source checkout, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
